description: Execute code across any of the 10 Eschaton engine suites (Omni, Apex, Void, Complexity, Sanitizer, MemoryProfile, FileIO, DBMS, SpecialJudge) with custom testcase matrices.

checker_code.description: Custom validator checker source code for SpecialJudge suite

language_id.description: Language ID (e.g. 54 for C++, 71 for Python 3, 202 for C++20, 204 for Python 3.11)

test_cases.description: List of testcases with stdin, expected_output, and optional schema_sql or files

verbose.description: Verbose mode (0=early-exit short-circuit, 1=full diagnostics for Void suite)

name: eschaton_execute_suite
